records.title: Split at the playhead
records.body: A split creates two source-contiguous clips without changing original media. Select a clip and place the playhead inside its duration, then preview the split before applying.
records.notes: Original KRIYA guidance; source URL is supporting reference, not copied source prose.

records.title: Trim a clip
records.body: Trimming changes the referenced source range. Drag an edge within available source media. Check picture and audio sync after shortening a shot.
records.notes: Original KRIYA guidance; source URL is supporting reference, not copied source prose.

records.title: Speed and duration
records.body: Increasing playback speed shortens the visible duration for the same source range. KRIYA previews a selected-clip speed edit through validated commands; inspect neighboring clips for gaps.
records.notes: Original KRIYA guidance; source URL is supporting reference, not copied source prose.

records.title: Duplicate safely
records.body: A duplicate references the same immutable source media. It is a separate timeline clip. Check its target track, placement and overlap in the preview.
records.notes: Original KRIYA guidance; source URL is supporting reference, not copied source prose.

records.title: Delete versus ripple delete
records.body: Deleting a clip can leave a gap. Ripple deletion shifts later material and can affect synchronization across tracks. The current agent proposes ordinary delete only.
records.notes: Original KRIYA guidance; source URL is supporting reference, not copied source prose.

records.title: Build a story before effects
records.body: Start with the intended audience and one clear outcome. Assemble a rough beginning, development and ending, then review continuity before adding decorative effects.
records.notes: Original KRIYA guidance; source URL is supporting reference, not copied source prose.

records.title: Review pacing
records.body: Watch the cut once without editing. Mark moments that repeat information or obscure an action. Adjust shot length deliberately; there is no universally correct cut frequency.
records.notes: Original KRIYA guidance; source URL is supporting reference, not copied source prose.

records.title: Continuity review
records.body: Review screen direction, eyelines and the action around each cut. A deliberate jump cut may suit a style, but accidental spatial or temporal jumps can distract.
records.notes: Original KRIYA guidance; source URL is supporting reference, not copied source prose.

records.title: Use supporting pictures
records.body: Use relevant supporting pictures to explain speech or bridge a visual edit. Keep source provenance and verify permission before adding footage.
records.notes: Original KRIYA guidance; source URL is supporting reference, not copied source prose.

records.title: Check audio continuity
records.body: Prioritize intelligible dialogue. Listen across every cut for discontinuities, sudden level changes and missing ambience. Gain changes in this editor are metadata operations; preview export audio support is limited.
records.notes: Original KRIYA guidance; source URL is supporting reference, not copied source prose.

records.title: Gain is not loudness normalization
records.body: Clip gain scales signal amplitude; it is not an integrated loudness measurement. Final loudness and true-peak verification require appropriate audio analysis tools.
records.notes: Original KRIYA guidance; source URL is supporting reference, not copied source prose.

records.title: Readable captions
records.body: Captions should represent speech and relevant sounds, stay readable and have reviewed timing. KRIYA does not yet run a live transcription service; do not invent a transcript.
records.notes: Original KRIYA guidance; source URL is supporting reference, not copied source prose.

records.title: Text contrast
records.body: Preview titles against the actual moving background. Use strong contrast and enough reading time. A quiet panel or shadow may help where the background changes.
records.notes: Original KRIYA guidance; source URL is supporting reference, not copied source prose.

records.title: Aspect ratio and framing
records.body: Changing output dimensions changes framing, not the source asset. Review faces, titles and action near the edges in every target format.
records.notes: Original KRIYA guidance; source URL is supporting reference, not copied source prose.

records.title: Frame rate and timing
records.body: Project frame rate defines the timing grid. Mixing source frame rates can create repeated or dropped pictures; inspect motion instead of assuming a metadata change creates new frames.
records.notes: Original KRIYA guidance; source URL is supporting reference, not copied source prose.

records.title: Container versus codec
records.body: A container packages tracks; a codec describes how a track is encoded. An MP4 filename alone does not guarantee decoder support. Check the actual track codecs and browser capabilities.
records.notes: Original KRIYA guidance; source URL is supporting reference, not copied source prose.

records.title: Preview versus final render
records.body: KRIYA currently creates a browser canvas WebM picture preview. It is not an authoritative H.264 MP4 render, and it is not a complete audio mix. Keep the editable manifest and originals.
records.notes: Original KRIYA guidance; source URL is supporting reference, not copied source prose.

records.title: Resolution and scaling
records.body: Choose dimensions for the delivery target. Enlarging a low-resolution image does not recover missing detail. Inspect the result at its intended viewing size.
records.notes: Original KRIYA guidance; source URL is supporting reference, not copied source prose.

records.title: Color pipeline limits
records.body: Keep the project color-space assumptions consistent. Browser previews are not a calibrated grading pipeline; do not claim verified HDR delivery or accurate display color from an ordinary preview.
records.notes: Original KRIYA guidance; source URL is supporting reference, not copied source prose.

records.title: Protect source originals
records.body: Edits reference immutable original media and source ranges. Store derivatives separately and preserve provenance. Never replace the original bytes to implement a timeline edit.
records.notes: Original KRIYA guidance; source URL is supporting reference, not copied source prose.

records.title: Metadata is not media backup
records.body: Cloud checkpoints and exported manifests contain project metadata, not source media bytes. Browser storage can be lost or evicted. Back up originals independently.
records.notes: Original KRIYA guidance; source URL is supporting reference, not copied source prose.

records.title: Versioned editing
records.body: Every agent edit uses the current project ID and timeline version. A proposal becomes stale when timeline or selection changes. Preview again rather than applying an old command.
records.notes: Original KRIYA guidance; source URL is supporting reference, not copied source prose.

records.title: Check rights before reuse
records.body: Public availability does not establish reuse permission. Record the source, license, attribution requirements and any subject consent. Treat unclear rights as unresolved.
records.notes: Original KRIYA guidance; source URL is supporting reference, not copied source prose.

records.title: People and consent
records.body: Do not infer a person's permission from a publicly accessible image or voice. Obtain documented rights and consent before any future identity-based generation workflow.
records.notes: Original KRIYA guidance; source URL is supporting reference, not copied source prose.

records.title: Explicit agent memory
records.body: Store only notes you explicitly want the agent to remember. Local notes stay in this browser; cloud notes are scoped to the signed-in user and active workspace. Delete a note to exclude it from future requests.
records.notes: Original KRIYA guidance; source URL is supporting reference, not copied source prose.

records.title: Preview before mutation
records.body: The brain can suggest a supported clip operation. It cannot execute shell commands, publish content or modify source media. Preview and explicit approval still gate every edit.
records.notes: Original KRIYA guidance; source URL is supporting reference, not copied source prose.

records.title: Choose what reaches a model
records.body: Offline advice sends nothing to an external model. Cloud reasoning sends the current question, retrieved knowledge, explicit cloud notes and a numerical project summary. No original video bytes are included.
records.notes: Original KRIYA guidance; source URL is supporting reference, not copied source prose.

records.title: Knowledge is not model training
records.body: KRIYA retrieves relevant source-backed records and supplies a bounded context to the hosted model. Adding records changes retrievable knowledge; it does not change the model weights or train video generation.
records.notes: Original KRIYA guidance; source URL is supporting reference, not copied source prose.

records.title: Plan proxy processing
records.body: For large video, a separate worker can make proxies and thumbnails while retaining the originals. KRIYA has no managed proxy worker yet; a lightweight preview is not a replacement for source media.
records.notes: Original KRIYA guidance; source URL is supporting reference, not copied source prose.

records.title: Final review checklist
records.body: Review the whole cut for missing media, gaps, bad framing, unintended overlaps and title errors. Then check sound, captions, source rights and target format separately.
records.notes: Original KRIYA guidance; source URL is supporting reference, not copied source prose.
